svm.note: Wrapped in CalibratedClassifierCV (sigmoid); reduced space vs full SVC(probability=True) grid — equal n_trials, not removed.

conformal.selection_note: A priori marginal_split (simplest finite-sample guarantee). Mondrian / CV+ reported in comparison; not selected by test coverage.

protocol_note: selection_biased: argmax pooled outer-OOF QWK over model×imputer. nested_unbiased: per outer fold pick model×imputer by inner QWK only. pooled_oof vs mean_fold are both reported for every candidate.

selection_biased.note: Optimistic: model×imputer chosen using the same outer OOF scores reported.

nested_unbiased.note: Unbiased: model×imputer selected inside each outer fold on inner QWK only.
